product_code.description: Unique product code identifier for the item, if provided.
product_code.title: Product Code

description.description: Text description of the product or service.
description.title: Description

quantity.description: Quantity of the item purchased or used.
quantity.title: Quantity

amount.description: Single monetary amount associated with the line item.
amount.title: Amount

amounts.description: List of monetary amounts when the line item has multiple separate charges.
amounts.title: Amounts

supplier_name.description: Name of the supplier issuing the receipt.
supplier_name.title: Supplier Name

receipt_date.description: Date when the receipt was issued.
receipt_date.title: Receipt Date

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction.
currency.title: Currency

line_items.description: List of individual line items included in the receipt.
line_items.title: Line Items

total_tax_amount.description: Total amount of taxes applied to the receipt.
total_tax_amount.title: Total Tax Amount

supplier_address.description: Full postal address of the supplier.
supplier_address.title: Supplier Address

supplier_city.description: City where the supplier is located.
supplier_city.title: Supplier City
